review_notice: Unapproved landscape candidates for comparison only. Captain-requested S005 arm repair is selected as v010: two distinct shoulder-to-hand arm paths, no merged forearms, and a clearly visible thigh-resting hand; the temple-hand thumb is obscured where that hand meets the head. Skin-only 11x11 sample medians have R-B 86–119, within the plan target. S005 v009 is preserved as a superseded skin-color attempt with samples above target. S001–S004 and S006–S010 remain byte-identical to the live selection. A fresh independent exact-checksum review of all ten is pending against the final plan. Caption mapping is unchanged; photos 011–014 remain unmapped extras. Portrait production remains paused; no artwork is approved.
visual_review_status: producer-reviewed S005 v010; fresh independent full exact-checksum review pending for all ten selected landscape candidates against the final plan and character contracts

rows.scene: A single all-pervading presence and varied flames evoke the chapter’s first teaching.
rows.candidate_status: Three groups of distinct logs carry small, medium and large flames against the cosmic spiral; no people or text appear. Independent exact-checksum review pending; no artwork approval.

rows.scene: The guru instructs an attentive seated disciple beside the two crossed aranis.
rows.candidate_status: Exactly two generic seated figures: the older guru faces and instructs the attentive disciple beside the two crossed aranis; both logs remain distinct beneath a small fire and separate branch tangle. At native and enlarged views each figure has one head, two arms, two hands, two legs and two feet; visible hands show five digits and each of four bare feet shows five toes. Skin-only 11x11 medians: guru cheek (545,217) RGB (150,76,38) R-B 112; torso (410,320) (153,77,39) R-B 114; disciple cheek (1280,215) (152,80,43) R-B 109; torso (1295,315) (152,78,40) R-B 112. No readable text. Producer reviewed; fresh independent exact-checksum review pending; no artwork approval.

rows.scene: Bhattathiri turns from temporary remedies toward Bhagwan’s refuge.
rows.candidate_status: DISCLOSED DEVIATION: Bhattathiri is kneeling with folded lower legs rather than seated as specified. One exposed foot shows five toes; the other is tucked; Bhagwan’s visible open blessing hand shows five digits and both visible feet show five toes. DISCLOSED DEVIATION: warm-brown skin target is R-B below 120. Independent reviewer’s skin-only 11x11 patches, using crop-origin coordinates, measured cheek origin (350,310) RGB (184,104,58) R-B 126 and torso origin (280,480) RGB (187,111,66) R-B 121. My exact-check remeasurement at the same origins matched. Additional skin-only origins: cheek (360,320) RGB (180,101,54) R-B 126; upper arm/torso (250,490) RGB (155,80,42) R-B 113. These two reviewer patches exceed target; no regeneration because repair rounds are exhausted. Producer reinspection pass with disclosed deviations; independent exact-checksum re-review pending; no artwork approval.

rows.scene: Even the highest celestial realm is unsettled; the poet seeks refuge and release.
rows.candidate_status: Bhattathiri’s head, eyes and folded prayer hands face Bhagwan at right; both legs and feet are naturally tucked beneath the dhoti and not visible. Brahma has four distinct heads and four attached arms; Bhagwan’s visible open hands each show thumb plus four fingers. DISCLOSED DEVIATION: Bhattathiri’s warm-brown skin remains above the R-B below-about-120 target. Existing 11x11 face/torso patch RGB medians (194,111,71), (186,107,72), (180,97,60) have R-B 123/114/120; torso RGB medians (210,124,82), (201,124,91), (200,115,75) have R-B 128/110/125, with face/torso group medians 120/125. Independent reviewer upper-arm/torso origin (690,660) measured RGB (205,115,71), R-B 134; adjacent origins (670,645) and (680,650) measured R-B 127 and 128. My same-origin remeasurements matched; my additional skin-only cheek origin (645,455) measured RGB (198,114,77), R-B 121. Across recorded skin-only face/torso/upper-arm samples, R-B ranges from 110 to 134; 134 is the highest measurement and exceeds the prior disclosed peak of 128. No regeneration; the full range is disclosed. Producer reinspection pass; fresh independent exact-checksum review pending; no artwork approval.

rows.scene: One connected tree holds both dream and waking; the reclining figure now has two clearly separated arms, with the second hand visible on the thigh.
rows.candidate_status: One generic reclining figure rests on the connected dream/waking tree; the mango cluster and waking-side lotus remain. Native and enlarged views show exactly two attached arms from distinct shoulders: one bends to support the head, and the other runs separately along the side to a clearly visible thigh-resting hand; the forearms do not overlap or merge. There are two separate hands: the thigh hand shows a thumb and four fingers; the temple hand shows four fingers, with its thumb obscured by head contact. One head, two legs, two feet, and five toes on each visible foot. Skin-only 11x11 median samples: cheek center (240,430) RGB (101,41,15), R-B 86; torso center (280,520) (138,62,29), R-B 109; upper arm center (360,420) (154,72,37), R-B 117; forearm center (450,415) (157,75,40), R-B 117; bent forearm center (140,500) (164,82,45), R-B 119. Samples remain below the plan target of about 120. No second person, text, logo, watermark, rays, or obvious artifact. Producer-reviewed pass with disclosed hand-occlusion limitation; fresh independent full exact-checksum review pending; no artwork approval.

His namaste has five visible fingertip ends with thumbs overlapped. Guruvayurappan's two open hands each show thumb plus four fingers. Bhattathiri 11x11 skin-only medians: cheek origin (390,300) RGB (161,84,47) R-B 114; torso (360,420) (195,107,65) R-B 130; arm (390,470) (141,75,40) R-B 101. The enlarged lower-body view shows four attached cow legs and four distinct hooves; the empty bowl and flower remain. Producer-reviewed pass; fresh independent exact-checksum review pending; no artwork approval.
